curriculumFinding: Reconstructed one coherent complete 180-EC route with 26 unique components: Year 1 common 36 + ISS 24; Year 2 common 12 + ISS 30 + sustainability theme 18; Year 3 mobility 30 + Senior Seminar 6 + theme capstone 12 + ISS thesis 12. Three old major/theme buckets are removed. Named required theme courses each 6 EC; remaining approved 6-EC theme elective is genuine restricted choice, not a replacement for missing compulsory courses. GROW 0 EC remains outside credits. All formal major/theme structures and approved choice are explicit; no essential ambiguity requires further regulations.

routeSelection.route: Interdisciplinary Social Sciences; Transformations to Sustainability
routeSelection.basis: No general/default route is advertised. Interdisciplinary Social Sciences is selected as the broadest social-science route, spanning sociology, economics, business, law and philosophy plus qualitative/quantitative inquiry, rather than the more focused brain, law/culture or design/technology majors. Themes are equally specialised; published order breaks the tie in favour of Transformations to Sustainability. The first two listed major electives, Statistics 2 and Sociological Themes, preserve broad methods and disciplinary inquiry. These choices are independent of UCR fit. The third approved theme elective and mobility window remain genuine choice.

conflictResolution: Main curriculum explicitly lists FOUR majors and dedicated D&T confirms the fourth, correcting the stored three-major statement. Dedicated ISS states BSc; generic BA labels in shared tables do not override route-specific degree. Other major pages carry a copied ISS table heading, but their page identities and named major course lists are controlling, not a mixed ISS curriculum.
